design_philosophy: Premium Fintech SaaS. Functional beauty meets high-end minimalism. Pure white surfaces, deep tinted typography, and controlled, dense grids. The interface must inspire trust and absolute clarity, avoiding decorative clutter while using refined micro-interactions and soft shadows for depth.

headings.usage: Use for Page Titles, Section Headers, and large KPI numbers.

body.usage: Use for all standard text, labels, and UI elements.

data_numbers.usage: MANDATORY for all financial metrics, prices, P&L, Win Rate, and tables. Mono fonts ensure decimal points and numbers align perfectly.

typography.installation_instructions: Load Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi via Fontshare API. Load JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts.

sidebar_navigation.style: Fixed left, pure white background, 1px right border (#E8E8F1). Active state for links should have a subtle #F3E8FF background with #7C3AED text and a 3px left border indicator.

dashboard_grid.structure: Top left dominating metric (Equity Curve: col-span-8), Quick Stats row below or alongside, smaller cards (col-span-4) for Trade Calendar, Recent Trades, and AI Insights. Dense but breathable.

login_page.layout: Centered Glassmorphism Card (max-w-md) on top of a highly visual background.
login_page.background_animation: Use `react-tsparticles` for floating subtle particles and Framer Motion to draw abstract candlestick/line chart SVG patterns in the background. Incorporate soft glowing radial gradients using `#7C3AED` with low opacity behind the card.
login_page.card_design: Pure white, 24px radius, soft drop shadow. Include Google Auth button with modern styling (icon left, centered text, 1px border).

components_needed: Quick Stats (P&L, Win Rate, Profit Factor)
dashboard.chart_style: Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Line charts for Equity Curve must use the primary purple `#7C3AED` with a gradient fill under the line (`from-[#7C3AED]/20 to-transparent`).

add_trade.layout: Multi-section form using a clean layout. Sections: Trade Details, Entry Confirmation, Strategy/Psychology Tags, Image Upload.
components_needed: Drag & Drop Upload Zone (dashed border, #F6F6FB bg)

features: AI Coach insight cards (use light purple bg for AI tips)

trade_view.layout: Master-Detail view or full Data Table with a slide-out side panel for individual trade details. Use compact table cells, align numbers to the right, and use `JetBrains Mono` for all price data.

buttons.primary: bg-[#7C3AED] hover:bg-[#6D28D9] text-white rounded-xl px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(124,58,237,0.2)]
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-[#E8E8F1] hover:bg-[#F6F6FB] text-[#16151F] rounded-xl px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-[#F3E8FF] text-[#6D6D82] hover:text-[#7C3AED] rounded-xl px-4 py-2 transition-all

cards.base_classes: bg-white rounded-[24px] border border-[#E8E8F1] shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(22,21,31,0.03)] p-6

chips_tags.style: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-medium border

motion.transitions: Use `transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out` for interactive elements.
motion.page_load: Use `framer-motion` for subtle page load stagger effects (fade in, translate-y-4).
motion.hover: Cards should have a slight `-translate-y-[2px]` and shadow increase on hover.

image_urls.usage: Use as a very subtle, low-opacity base behind the login glassmorphism card.
Use as the user profile avatar in the sidebar or header.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over primary buttons meets WCAG AA standards.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#7C3AED]/50 focus:outline-none`.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color hex codes provided. DO NOT use generic Tailwind blues or grays. Use the tinted background #F6F6FB.
Use Shadcn UI components but override their default borders and border-radiuses. Change Shadcn's default rounded-md to rounded-2xl or rounded-[24px] for cards to match the premium SaaS feel.
For the Login Page, create a custom component using `react-tsparticles` for the background, layered under a centered glass card. Add a Google Sign In button.
Ensure all monetary values and percentages use the JetBrains Mono font class.
Never use `transparent` backgrounds for dropdowns or modals. They must have a solid white background and a high z-index.
Implement the Layout component with a fixed Sidebar on the left and a scrollable main content area on the right.
Use modern pill-shaped or rounded-xl buttons, not harsh square buttons.
For charts, use Recharts. Make the lines smooth (type='monotone') and use the primary purple color with gradient fills.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic by applying the custom fonts, generous spacing (p-6, p-8), and exact color tokens specified.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft custom shadows instead of harsh default Tailwind shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all` globally). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS. Respect natural reading flows.
NEVER use placeholder text (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, active states, and entrance animations.
